correctness.rationale: Explicit reproducible code enumerates 3048 cap faces and an acyclic matching of 1484 pairs, checking every vertex of the reversed Hasse DAG. Critical dimensions are 0:1, 3:1, 4:78; the exact signed Morse boundary has gcd 2, giving rational homology exclusively in degree four, rank 77. Independently all 20160 invertible binary 4x4 matrices are partitioned into 14 full conjugacy classes, and the reduced Lefschetz character is checked on every element; a separate signed oriented fixed-face calculation agrees for all class representatives. Integer Jacobi-Trudi formula checks the 7+70 Specht sum on all classes and irreducible inner products exactly 1. Weighted trace sum 0 implies no invariants and rational acyclicity of the finite quotient. The provided standalone scripts replay these finite certificates.

originality.rationale: The precise new claim is the full rational 20160-element collineation-group action on 77-dimensional fourth homology and its decomposition under A8. A previously available same-object homotopy classification determines the rank and 2-torsion but does not fix any nonidentity trace.
